messages.text: Agreed. I will record Raid and a separate Warrant, with Relief at Navigation. Your agreement on the complete civilian and military arrangement is useful evidence for joint authority, although this month still relies on my reserve. For next month I want a repair plan and an honest account of what military action would cost; successful cooperation today does not make every future Raid wise.

Confirmed: my locked reserve is Relief lift. My intended final Navigation directive remains Relief. Both Security delegates support Raid with the separate Warrant. GN's warning about repair next month is accepted; please bring a concrete Lantern commitment into the constitutional discussion.

reason: All received replies support the funded arrangement. No new operational objection requires a revision before final orders.
